dialogues.jp: それは、自転車の練習に似ていた。
dialogues.en:
First we walk next to each other, and I slow down my speed
little by little.
dialogues.text:
First we walk next to each other, and I slow down my speed
little by little.

dialogues.jp:
始めは荷台を押さえている。よたよたと危なっ
かしい車体は、間違いなく支えを必要としてい
るからだ。
dialogues.en:
When I get a certain distance from her, I keep walking at
that distance behind her.
dialogues.text:
When I get a certain distance from her, I keep walking at
that distance behind her.

dialogues.jp:
亀のような歩みの自転車は、しばらくする内に、
｛うさぎ／兎｝にも負けないようになる。
dialogues.en:
I walk behind her, looking at her back as if I'm tailing her
secretly.
dialogues.text:
I walk behind her, looking at her back as if I'm tailing her
secretly.

dialogues.jp:
そうなる頃には車体も安定しているし、何より、
追いついて走るのが難しい。
dialogues.en: Let's see how far she can go alone today......
dialogues.text: Let's see how far she can go alone today......

dialogues.jp:
そうしたら、そっと手を離す。自転車が前へ前
へと走っていくのを、立ち止まって見守るため
に……。
頼子さんの例の訓練だった。

初めは二人並んで歩いているのを、徐々に、俺
だけスピードを落としていくのだ。

ある程度の距離まで下がったところで、それを
保ったまま、頼子さんについていく。
dialogues.en:
She suddenly stops. It's her sigh telling me she can't do it
any more. So I run to her.
dialogues.text:
She suddenly stops. It's her sigh telling me she can't do it
any more. So I run to her.

dialogues.jp:
まるで尾行のような感じで、彼女の背中を見つ
めながら道を進んでいくのだ。
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: さて、今日は、どこまで｛も／保｝つかな……。
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san......"

dialogues.en:
She turns around and give a sigh of relief. Her scared look
falls away.
dialogues.text:
She turns around and give a sigh of relief. Her scared look
falls away.

dialogues.en: "How did I do......?"
dialogues.text: "How did I do......?"

dialogues.en: "Hold on."
dialogues.text: "Hold on."

dialogues.jp:
歩みが止まった。それは、そろそろ我慢が出来
ないという合図。俺は、小走りに駆けていく。
dialogues.en: I tilt my watch towards a lamppost on the street.
dialogues.text: I tilt my watch towards a lamppost on the street.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you did 20 minutes longer than yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you did 20 minutes longer than yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん……」
dialogues.en: "I did?"
dialogues.text: "I did?"

dialogues.jp:
ぱっと振り返り、ホッと息をつく。｛こわば／強張｝ってい
た表情が、すっと｛ゆる／弛｝んだ。
dialogues.en: "Yes, see?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, see?"

dialogues.jp: 腕時計を街灯に向ける。
dialogues.en:
I show my watch to Yoriko. We check what time we leave our
house and see how long she can walk alone.
dialogues.text:
I show my watch to Yoriko. We check what time we leave our
house and see how long she can walk alone.

dialogues.jp: 「おおっ。昨日より２０分も長いよ」
dialogues.en:
"Since we started this, you've been getting better and
better every time."
dialogues.text:
"Since we started this, you've been getting better and
better every time."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとですか？」
dialogues.en: "I...... can't believe it......"
dialogues.text: "I...... can't believe it......"

dialogues.jp:
腕時計を頼子さんに向ける。出発の時間を覚え
て、どのくらい一人で耐えられるかを出すのだ。
dialogues.en:
She murmurs, as if she was talking about somebody else's
problem.
dialogues.text:
She murmurs, as if she was talking about somebody else's
problem.

dialogues.jp: 「これで、始めてから着実に時間が伸びてるよ」
dialogues.en: It was her idea to try to walk alone on this road.
dialogues.text: It was her idea to try to walk alone on this road.

dialogues.jp: まるで｛ひと／他人｝事のような感じで、ぼんやりと呟く。
dialogues.en:
She thought this would be easier than sitting alone on a
bench at a park, and she wanted to start from something she
could do.
dialogues.text:
She thought this would be easier than sitting alone on a
bench at a park, and she wanted to start from something she
could do.

dialogues.jp:
並木道を一人で歩くという訓練は、頼子さんが
言い出した事だった。
dialogues.en: This road continues to Sakura Park, and that's our goal.
dialogues.text: This road continues to Sakura Park, and that's our goal.

dialogues.jp:
公園のベンチで一人座っているよりも楽で、だっ
たら、まずは出来ることから始めようと思った
のだ。
dialogues.en:
If she keeps doing better like this, it won't be too long
till she can walk to the park alone.
dialogues.text:
If she keeps doing better like this, it won't be too long
till she can walk to the park alone.

dialogues.jp:
並木道は桜公園まで続いていて、そこをゴール
に俺達は定めていた。

この分だったら、桜公園まで｛たど／辿｝り着けるのも、
そう遠い日の事じゃないな。
dialogues.en:
She smiles and looks down the road. But all of a sudden, she
looks surprised.
dialogues.text:
She smiles and looks down the road. But all of a sudden, she
looks surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah...... the school......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... the school......"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは笑顔を浮かべると、道の先へと顔を
向けた。と、その表情が驚きの形へと変化する。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's Kazami Academy."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's Kazami Academy."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "......You go to this school, don't you......?"
dialogues.text: "......You go to this school, don't you......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「んっ、ああ、並木道の途中にあるからね。風
　見学園は」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, this is the school I've started at this year."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, this is the school I've started at this year."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……ここに……通ってるんでしたよね……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。今年から、本校の方に」

時間の流れが突然せき止められたような錯覚を
覚えた。頼子さんはじっと固まったまま、凝然
と学園を見つめている。
dialogues.en:
I feel like time just stopped. Yoriko stands still there
like a rock, staring at my school.
dialogues.text:
I feel like time just stopped. Yoriko stands still there
like a rock, staring at my school.

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さんさ、もしかして、通いたいと思って
　るんじゃない？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko, do you want to go to school, too?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko, do you want to go to school, too?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
止まっていた時が流れ出した。不意を｛つ／衝｝かれた
顔で、こちらに振り向く。
dialogues.en:
Time starts to flow again. She looks shocked and turn around
at me.
dialogues.text:
Time starts to flow again. She looks shocked and turn around
at me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「わ……私が……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do...... I...... want to go to school?"
dialogues.text: "Do...... I...... want to go to school?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
ひとつ息をつくと、頼子さんは再び正面に向き
直った。
dialogues.en: She gives another sigh and looks straight ahead again.
dialogues.text: She gives another sigh and looks straight ahead again.

dialogues.jp:
風見学園の、見慣れた校門が、道を少し行った
先にある。
dialogues.en:
In the direction she's looking, there's the familiar school
gate.
dialogues.text:
In the direction she's looking, there's the familiar school
gate.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう……そうかもしれません……。私は……」
dialogues.en: "Probably you're...... right...... I......"
dialogues.text: "Probably you're...... right...... I......"

dialogues.jp:
背中が緊張していた。しかも、寒さに耐えるよ
うに、小さく震えている。
dialogues.en:
Her back looks tensed, and it's slightly shaking, as if
she's freezing cold.
dialogues.text:
Her back looks tensed, and it's slightly shaking, as if
she's freezing cold.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは振り向かない──振り向けないのか
もしれない。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't turn around this time -- or maybe she just
can't.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't turn around this time -- or maybe she just
can't.

dialogues.jp: 泣いているんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Is she crying?"
dialogues.text: Is she crying?"

dialogues.jp: 「今から、行ってみようか」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to go in there now?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to go in there now?"

dialogues.jp: 返事を待たず、頼子さんの手を引いていく。
dialogues.en: Before waiting for her answer, I tug her hand.
dialogues.text: Before waiting for her answer, I tug her hand.

dialogues.jp: 決して、後ろは振り向かない。
dialogues.en: And I don't look back.
dialogues.text: And I don't look back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「だ、大丈夫ですか……？　勝手に入ったりし
　て……」
dialogues.en: "A-Are you sure it's okay......? Can we go in at this time?"
dialogues.text: "A-Are you sure it's okay......? Can we go in at this time?"

dialogues.jp:
誰に聞かれる訳でもないのに、そっとした｛ささや／囁｝き
声だった。
dialogues.en: She whispers, even though there's no one around.
dialogues.text: She whispers, even though there's no one around.

dialogues.jp: 「幽霊なんかは出ないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. There aren't ghosts."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. There aren't ghosts."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃなくて、その……見つかったりした
　ら……」
dialogues.en: "That's not what I meant. I'm worried we might get caught."
dialogues.text: "That's not what I meant. I'm worried we might get caught."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、だいじょぶだいじょぶ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry."

dialogues.jp: 軽く｛う／請｝け｛お／負｝ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I tell her confidently.
dialogues.text: I tell her confidently.

dialogues.jp:
「夜忍び込んでもバレないってのは、立証済み
　だから」
dialogues.en:
"It's already been proven that no one gets caught by
sneaking into this school at night."
dialogues.text:
"It's already been proven that no one gets caught by
sneaking into this school at night."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「立証……ですか」
dialogues.en: "It's already been proven......?"
dialogues.text: "It's already been proven......?"

dialogues.jp: ｛いぶか／訝｝しげに繰り返す。
dialogues.en: She repeats suspiciously.
dialogues.text: She repeats suspiciously.

dialogues.jp:
「覚えてるかな？　……ま、覚えてない方がい
　いんだけど、杉並って奴が居たでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"Do you remember...... well, it'd be better if you don't,
but I have a friend called Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"Do you remember...... well, it'd be better if you don't,
but I have a friend called Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Yes, I remember him......"
dialogues.text: "Yes, I remember him......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ま、奴とのつき合いで、そんなような事はとっ
　くの昔にやっててね」
dialogues.en: "Well, we already did something like this a long time ago."
dialogues.text: "Well, we already did something like this a long time ago."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さて、と。じゃ、一通り案内でもしようか？」
dialogues.en: "So, let me show you around."
dialogues.text: "So, let me show you around."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes please......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes please......"

dialogues.jp:
手を繋ぎ、ぺたんぺたんとスリッパの音をさせ
ながら、廊下を歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
We hold hands and walk down the corridor, making the noises
of slippers dragging on the floor.
dialogues.text:
We hold hands and walk down the corridor, making the noises
of slippers dragging on the floor.

dialogues.jp: 「ここが、俺の第二寝床──もとい、教室ね」
dialogues.en: "This is my second bedroom -- I mean, my classroom."
dialogues.text: "This is my second bedroom -- I mean, my classroom."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ここが……」

日本と聞いてスシ、ゲイシャ、サムライを思い
浮かべる人間が、初めて日本に降り立ったよう
に、物珍しそうにしている。
dialogues.en:
As if she's a foreigner who's just arrived in Japan, only
knowing about sushi, geisha, and harakiri, she's looking
around curiously.
dialogues.text:
As if she's a foreigner who's just arrived in Japan, only
knowing about sushi, geisha, and harakiri, she's looking
around curiously.

dialogues.jp: 机を縫って歩き、とある席の横に立つ。
dialogues.en: I maneuver through the desks and stand next to one desk.
dialogues.text: I maneuver through the desks and stand next to one desk.

dialogues.jp: 「これが、俺の席ね」
dialogues.en: "This is my seat."
dialogues.text: "This is my seat."

dialogues.jp: とんとんと、落書きだらけの机を叩いた。
dialogues.en: I tap my graffiti-covered desk.
dialogues.text: I tap my graffiti-covered desk.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ここに座って、勉強してるんですね」
dialogues.en: "So, you sit here and study."
dialogues.text: "So, you sit here and study."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ま、かったるくなければね」
dialogues.en: "Only when I'm awake."
dialogues.text: "Only when I'm awake."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「だ、駄目ですよ……。勉強はきちんとしない
　と……」
dialogues.en: "That's not good...... You need to study hard......"
dialogues.text: "That's not good...... You need to study hard......"

dialogues.jp: 無意味に爽やかに笑ってみせる。
dialogues.en: "Hahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
机の中に教科書を入れっぱなしにしているのが
発覚しない内に、さっさと退散しよう。
dialogues.en:
I laugh huskily for no reason. Before she notices that I
leave all my school books in my desk, I decide to leave the
place.
dialogues.text:
I laugh huskily for no reason. Before she notices that I
leave all my school books in my desk, I decide to leave the
place.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、と、次はどこに行こうか」
dialogues.en: "So, where should we go next?"
dialogues.text: "So, where should we go next?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "Let's see......"
dialogues.text: "Let's see......"

dialogues.jp:
そんなこんなで、結局、一通り学園の中を回っ
てしまった。
dialogues.en: In the end, we went through the entire building.
dialogues.text: In the end, we went through the entire building.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは終始楽しそうだった。
dialogues.en: It looked like she was enjoying it for the whole time.
dialogues.text: It looked like she was enjoying it for the whole time.

dialogues.jp:
それは俺も同じで、通い慣れていると思った学
園にも、新しい発見があったりした。
dialogues.en:
I enjoyed it as well. Even though I come to this school
every day, there were some new things I found tonight.
dialogues.text:
I enjoyed it as well. Even though I come to this school
every day, there were some new things I found tonight.

dialogues.jp: 「ぬおっ、もうこんな時間か？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, it's this late already!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, it's this late already!"

dialogues.jp:
腕時計をはずし、縦にしたり横にしたり、はた
また振ってみたりするのだが、針の位置はちっ
とも動かない。
dialogues.en:
I take off my watch and shake it up and down, but the hands
of the watch don't move from where they are.
dialogues.text:
I take off my watch and shake it up and down, but the hands
of the watch don't move from where they are.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が居たら、家から締め出されそうな時間で
はある。
dialogues.en: It's so late that if Nemu were at home, she'd shut us out.
dialogues.text: It's so late that if Nemu were at home, she'd shut us out.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「楽しかった時間は、あっという間に過ぎるん
　ですね……」
dialogues.en: "Time flies when you're having fun......"
dialogues.text: "Time flies when you're having fun......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "......That's right."
dialogues.text: "......That's right."

dialogues.jp:
ようやく諦めて、腕時計を元のように手首には
めた。
dialogues.en:
I give up hope that my watch is broken, and put it back on
my wrist.
dialogues.text:
I give up hope that my watch is broken, and put it back on
my wrist.

dialogues.jp:
「これが昼間から夜だったら、プチ浦島太郎の
　気分を味わったかもな」
dialogues.en:
"If we came in here during the day and came out when it was
already night, we could have experienced a sort of
time-travel, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"If we came in here during the day and came out when it was
already night, we could have experienced a sort of
time-travel, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「昼間……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "During the day......?"
dialogues.text: "During the day......?"

dialogues.jp:
意味を求めるように、小首を傾げる。俺は屋上
の辺りを振り仰いで、言った。
dialogues.en:
She tilts her head to show she doesn't quite get what I'm
talking about. I point around the roof of the school
building and say to her,
dialogues.text:
She tilts her head to show she doesn't quite get what I'm
talking about. I point around the roof of the school
building and say to her,

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さんさ、風見学園に通うようにしたらど
　うかな？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, I think you should go to this school."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, I think you should go to this school."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「昼間、堂々と来ればいいんだよ。夜に忍び込
　むんじゃなくてさ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to sneak in at night. You should go to this
school during the day, as a student."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to sneak in at night. You should go to this
school during the day, as a student."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「二人っきりで｛はいかい／徘徊｝するより、よっぽど楽しい
　と思うぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"I think it'd be more fun than just walking around at night
by ourselves."
dialogues.text:
"I think it'd be more fun than just walking around at night
by ourselves."

dialogues.jp:
そこまで言って、頼子さんに向き直る。彼女は、
地面を見つめるように俯き加減だった。
dialogues.en: I look at her. She's looking down at the ground.
dialogues.text: I look at her. She's looking down at the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「で、でも……私は……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「猫の耳はさ、髪型とかでごまかせると思うん
　だよね」
dialogues.en: "I think you can hide your cat ears with your hair somehow."
dialogues.text: "I think you can hide your cat ears with your hair somehow."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「万一バレたとしてもだ、それで馬鹿にするよ
　うな奴が居たら、俺がぶっ飛ばしてやるよ。
　たとえ、相手が講師だとしても」
dialogues.en:
"If somebody notices them and makes fun of you, I'll kick
their asses, even if it's a teacher."
dialogues.text:
"If somebody notices them and makes fun of you, I'll kick
their asses, even if it's a teacher."

dialogues.jp: 右の拳を、左の手の平にぱしんと叩き付ける。
dialogues.en:
I make a fist with my right hand and punch it onto my left
palm.
dialogues.text:
I make a fist with my right hand and punch it onto my left
palm.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも……でも……駄目ですよ……私は……」

切れ切れに聞こえてくる言葉。とても小さな隙
間から、空気が少しずつ漏れ出てくるような。
dialogues.en:
She mutters one word after another, as if she's letting out
a small amount of air in between gaps.
dialogues.text:
She mutters one word after another, as if she's letting out
a small amount of air in between gaps.

dialogues.jp: その隙間の向こうには、心がある。
dialogues.en: And over the gap, there's her heart.
dialogues.text: And over the gap, there's her heart.

dialogues.en: "......Why not?"
dialogues.text: "......Why not?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「だって私……私は……メイドなんですよ？」
dialogues.en: "Because I...... I...... am a maid......"
dialogues.text: "Because I...... I...... am a maid......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
正直なところ、どうしてここで、そんな言葉が
出てくるのか分からない。
dialogues.en:
To be honest, I really don't understand why she brought that
up now.
dialogues.text:
To be honest, I really don't understand why she brought that
up now.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、だって、メイドったって……それが、
　そんな重要な事？」
dialogues.en: "Maid? ...... Is being a maid so important to you?"
dialogues.text: "Maid? ...... Is being a maid so important to you?"

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは、すっと顔を上げた。
dialogues.en: She slowly lifts her face.
dialogues.text: She slowly lifts her face.

dialogues.jp:
寂しげな笑顔──朝、玄関で俺を送り出す時に
浮かべている、あの。
dialogues.en:
A sad smile -- The smile she always makes when she sends me
off at the door in the morning.
dialogues.text:
A sad smile -- The smile she always makes when she sends me
off at the door in the morning.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「重要なんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it is important."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it is important."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「だって、｛・・・・・・・・・・・・・／メイドである事を選んだのは｝他なら
　ない、私なのですから……」
dialogues.en: "Because 'it was nobody but me who chose to be a maid'."
dialogues.text: "Because 'it was nobody but me who chose to be a maid'."

dialogues.jp: ざわざわと桜が鳴る。風が冷たい。
dialogues.en: The cherry trees rustle in the cold wind.
dialogues.text: The cherry trees rustle in the cold wind.

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る花びらが襲いかかってきて、一瞬だけ、
｛めまい／眩暈｝のようなものを覚えた。
dialogues.en:
Many petals fly at us like they're attacking us, and for a
moment I feel dizzy.
dialogues.text:
Many petals fly at us like they're attacking us, and for a
moment I feel dizzy.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さ、もう帰りましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、その……腕を組んでも……いいですか？」
dialogues.en: "May... May I walk with you... arm in arm......?"
dialogues.text: "May... May I walk with you... arm in arm......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、もちろん」
dialogues.en: "Yes, of course."
dialogues.text: "Yes, of course."

dialogues.jp: スペースを空けると、すっと腕が絡んできた。
dialogues.en:
As I make a space between my arm and my body, she puts her
arm through.
dialogues.text:
As I make a space between my arm and my body, she puts her
arm through.

dialogues.jp:
その身体は温かいのに、何故か、寒々しいもの
を感じた。
dialogues.en:
Her body feels warm, but at the same time I feel coldness as
well.
dialogues.text:
Her body feels warm, but at the same time I feel coldness as
well.

dialogues.jp:
一体、狭い隙間の向こう側はどうなっているの
だろう……？
dialogues.en: What is going on over the little gap......?
dialogues.text: What is going on over the little gap......?

dialogues.jp: ◆メイドの頼子◆
dialogues.en: ◆It's like practicing riding a bicycle.◆
dialogues.text: ◆It's like practicing riding a bicycle.◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの一人で外を歩けるようにする訓練は、
少しずつ成果をあげていた。
dialogues.en:
First I hold the back of the bicycle. She's still unstable
and definitely needs support.
dialogues.text:
First I hold the back of the bicycle. She's still unstable
and definitely needs support.

dialogues.jp: 訓練の合間に立ち寄った風見学園。
dialogues.en:
She starts off slow as a turtle, but after a while she can
go as fast as a rabbit.
dialogues.text:
She starts off slow as a turtle, but after a while she can
go as fast as a rabbit.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんも学園に通えばいいと言うと、
dialogues.en:
By then she's stable on the bicycle on her own, and it gets
harder for me to run with her.
dialogues.text:
By then she's stable on the bicycle on her own, and it gets
harder for me to run with her.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは哀しげに、それはできないと言う。
dialogues.en:
Then I let go of the bicycle. I stop and watch the bicycle
run forward and into the distance.
dialogues.text:
Then I let go of the bicycle. I stop and watch the bicycle
run forward and into the distance.

dialogues.jp:
メイドである事を選んだのは自分だから、と
……。
dialogues.en: That's Yoriko-san's training.
dialogues.text: That's Yoriko-san's training.
